card.name: Number of days in duration phrases
card.fires_on: The digit 0 completing a number such as 10 in "for at least 10 days", and the word days after a number, in treatment duration phrases. Mostly seen in bosentan start instructions.

modes.label: Digit 0 in 10 days
modes.description: The final 0 of 10 in "for at least 10 days" before the word days, in bosentan co-administration instructions.
modes.example: In patients who have been receiving GENVOYA for at least 1<<0>> days, start bosentan at

modes.label: Days after a number
modes.description: The word days right after a number giving a course length.
modes.example: Duration of therapy studied and recommended for acute otitis media is 10<< days>>.

card.writes: It promotes time-unit words like weekly, weeks and month, so it anticipates a time span unit coming next.
card.plain: It fires when a text gives how many days a treatment is continued, such as at least 10 days.
